title: Gender Gaps in AI-adoption and Initiatives to Encourage Better AI Technologies Adoption in Educational and Workplace Settings
what_it_is: Gender Gaps in AI-adoption and Initiatives to Encourage Better AI Technologies Adoption in Educational and Workplace Settings

sections.label: Women in Singapore tech
sections.summary: A 2024 study found women are 40% of Singapore's tech workforce and 47% of GenAI users, with training and outreach initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: A study conducted by the Boston Consulting Group and the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) in May 2024 found that women make up 40% of Singapore's technological workforce, surpassing the global average of 37%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Based on web traffic data from SimilarWeb, 47% of Singapore users of GenAI tools are female, slightly higher than the global average of 43%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: Initiatives, such as the Singapore Women in Tech Movement, have championed efforts to attract, retain and develop women in technology.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: For workers, we have numerous SkillsFuture AI training courses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: For students, new AI for Fun modules will be introduced under the Code for Fun programme to expose primary and secondary schools to AI.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Digital Development and Information (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Digital Development and Information)
sentences.text: For the general public, the National Library Board's (NLB's) public outreach programmes, such as the Be SURE Together roadshows, incorporate GenAI content to educate them on the potentials and pitfalls of GenAI.

sections.label: Tracking participation on platform
sections.summary: The speaker says participation on an accessible platform should be tracked and will be looked into.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: It is done in a platform that is accessible for all.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: I believe there should be tracking of some of this participation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This is something that I will need to look into.
